purpose: Reconcile historical Eurospin legal-entity labels before assigning any of the 51 unreconciled current PUN partyIds.

investigated.classification: host/legal-entity labels; not promotable to independent CPO without partyId/EVSE operator proof
positiveEvidence: Eurospin sustainability material confirms EV charging infrastructure is installed at stores.

Current public evidence shows Eurospin-hosted charging can be operated by third-party CPOs: Electrip at Eurospin Valmontone; Ozzano municipality explicitly states the Eurospin site is among charging locations managed by different operators.
negativeEvidence: No current official Eurospin/Spesa Intelligente direct/ad-hoc national tariff grid found.
No deterministic evidence that the historical regional Eurospin legal entities correspond one-to-one to current PUN CPO partyIds.
Store ownership/host identity must not be treated as CPO identity.
investigated.deduplicationDecision: Do not create five independent CPO records from the historical labels. Resolve each current PUN partyId from EVSE/operator evidence first; where a Eurospin location is operated by an already-known CPO, retain the CPO and store Eurospin only as host/location metadata.
investigated.tariffDecision: No Eurospin tariff is rankable from these labels. Use the actual CPO direct/ad-hoc tariff only after deterministic EVSE-to-CPO mapping.
investigated.resumeCondition: Fresh PUN EVSE samples or first-party operator evidence tying a current IT*<partyId> to one of these legal entities as CPO, not merely site host.

next: Continue resolving the 51 unreconciled current PUN partyIds by EVSE count descending. For each resolved identity, test current direct network/class-wide tariff before station-level investigation. Atlante remains last.
